planets.name: TOI-2267 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2267 A with a 2.29-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-2267 b crosses its star every 2.29 days and is as wide as Earth, found in 2025.
text.introduction: TOI-2267 b transits TOI-2267 A every 2.29 days and is as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
